Name: Haley's photos cow
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

Replace the cows in Haley's photos with those from Harvest Moon.
To be used in conjunction with cow mods from Harvest Moon.
These -    https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/224
Or these - https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1119
Just one detail, but I saw the different cow photos, so I fixed them.

This is not a mod a it's two xnb files. Remember to make a backup of the originals. After unzipping the files, replace the originals with these in:
C:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/LooseSprites

Many thanks to all the creators of these beautiful cows.

I thank in advance anyone who believes that my work deserves at least the time to give a thumbs up.

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
